Date April 15th, 1932
Date 22 / 4 / 32）

Subject (in full) Allegation against C.P.C. 1127 Tong Kyung Goong (唐京宮)

Made by D.S. I. Palmer. Forwarded by

Sir,

At 2.15 p.m. 15.4.32, Messrs. Shimamura and T. Yoshida of the Chuka Senshoku Company, situated in the Zung Foo Li (頌福里) off North Szechuen Road,, came to the station and reported that at 1 p.m. to-day they witnessed C.P.C.1127 who was on duty, make a speech to seven or eight Chinese coolies at the junction of Z Ching and North Szechuen Road to the following effect:-

The majority of Japanese residents in this vicinity took the advantage of the recent hostilities and did a great deal of of business. The Japanese of the Tsung Wa Dying Factory (Chuka Senshoku) have stolen a large quantity of household goods and transported them to their factory in motor-trucks.

The two Japanese above, protested and asked the C.P.C. the reason for inciting the ignorant persons when there was no foundation. The C.P.C. pointing his finger to the sky replied that the facts were known to heaven.

To support the above complaint, informants wrote a letter through the medium of one Sadaichi Takematsu to the Inspector in charge and added that the C.P.C. also made another speech of an anti-Japanese nature. They also stated that owing to the danger during the recent trouble, over twenty of their Japanese staff took refuge in Hongkew District and upon returning the furniture was brought back.

Complainants request that as the C.P.C. was on duty for the purpose of preserving peace and good order, he should be severely cautioned.

A statement was taken in the Charge Room from the C.P.C. in question which reads to the following effect:-

编号 D 3542

日期 1932年4月22日）

事由（全称） 对华人警长（C.P.C.）1127号 唐京宮 的指控

由 副巡官（D.S.I.）Palmer 提出。经……转呈

先生，

1932年4月15日下午2时15分，位于北四川路頌福里的中华染色公司（Chuka Senshoku Company）的岛村（Shimamura）先生和吉田（T. Yoshida）先生来到捕房报案称，当日下午1时，他们目睹正在执勤的华人警长1127号在浙江路与北四川路交汇处向七八名中国苦力发表演讲，内容大致如下：

此间大多数日本居民利用最近的战事，做了大量生意。中华染色厂（Tsung Wa Dying Factory (Chuka Senshoku)）的日本人窃取了大量家居用品，并用汽车运至其工厂。

上述两名日本人提出抗议，询问该华人警长在毫无根据的情况下煽动无知民众的理由。该华人警长手指天空，回答说事实天知地知。

为支持上述投诉，举报人通过一位名为竹松贞一（Sadaichi Takematsu）的人士向主管督察写了一封信，并补充说该华人警长还发表了另一番反日言论。他们还表示，由于最近事变期间的危险，他们的二十多名日本职员曾避难于虹口区，返回后家具也被运回。

投诉人请求，鉴于该华人警长执勤的目的是维护和平与良好秩序，应对其予以严厉警告。

在拘留室对该涉案华人警长进行了问话记录，内容大致如下：

1932年4月15日下午1时50分，当沿浙

档案号__________
捕房，__________
日期 __________ 19

报告

事由（全称） ____________________ （续）。

由 ____________________ 提出 经 ____________________ 转呈

江路二号巡逻段行走时，一名中国妇女走近他，告知
她家中大量财物被盗。他指示她向狄思威路捕房报
案，她回答说，鉴于战事期间只有日本人能在该区通行，她怀疑
是日本人用汽车将财物运走。该妇女随
后离开。几分钟后，一名日本平民走来，
询问该华人警长是哪辆日本汽车运走了财物，他回答说，警察怎能乱说话。
该华人警长 ████ 称他随后继续巡逻。

此致，
B. Palmer
副巡官（D. S. I.）

转发给 A.O.。
A.S.）
